answer: Proof-of-burn mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy scarce tokens to mint credentials. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of incinerating capital as costly as saffron, recording the irreversible sacrifice on an onyx ledger. This economic barrier preserves an elevated mesa of legitimate agents. A key limitation is that burning capital favors wealthy adversaries, pricing low-resource honest agents out of participation.
